descriptions.w3d_d28e_reset_batches_801a966c: Reset a batch collector: creates its service on first use through the named factory at 0x80414ae0 and flags it, rewinds the two cursors at +180 and +204, clears the vectors at +240, +252 and +268, clears the block at +232, pushes the service as the first entry of the +268 vector, clears the mark at +280 and every element vector of the list at +288, and zeroes the two counters. Returns 0.
